chapter: Becoming a player; Rene, Bunk and Armstrong
title: How he got the nickname Nosey
summary: His nickname came from his habit of wanting to learn by listening to better players.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Why'd they call you Nosey? I don't call him my nose. Where did you put it? Huh? Where did you put your nose?
Where did I put it? Well I didn't put it anywhere.
You didn't stick your nose in other people's business.
Well I have done some of that too. I guess everybody sometimes knows to stick your nose in other people's business.
Well you always wanted to know. Yeah.

Well I tried to, the point that I was trying to rob, I was trying to learn. And I thought the best way to learn was to listen to people that played better than you. You can't learn anything from a fellow that don't play as much as you can.
